SELECT ext.assemble_id productId, ext.sort_number sortNumber, packageLink.id packageId, cargoLink.id cargoId, wrecord.id wareHouseRecordId, IFNULL( packageLink.id, 0 )+ IFNULL( cargoLink.id, 0 )+ IFNULL( wrecord.id, 0 )= 0 boolCanCange FROM tech_assemble_ext ext LEFT JOIN mes_building_package_number_link packageLink ON ext.assemble_id = packageLink.product_id AND packageLink.number = ext.sort_number AND packageLink.product_type = 16 AND packageLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_cargo_list_product_number_link cargoLink ON ext.assemble_id = cargoLink.product_id AND cargoLink.number = ext.sort_number AND cargoLink.product_type = 16 AND cargoLink.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND cargoLink.bool_cancel_ship = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_record wrecord ON ext.assemble_id = wrecord.product_id AND wrecord.number = ext.sort_number AND wrecord.product_type = 16 AND wrecord.type = 2 AND wrecord.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE
( ext.assemble_id= #{assNumber.productId} and ext.sort_number=#{assNumber.number})
and ext.bool_delete_enum = 0

select * from ( SELECT IF ( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.serial_number, ass.serial_number ) serial_number, IF ( complete.task_type_enum = 1, '零件-直发件', '部件-直发件' ) name, IF ( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.specification, ass.specification ) specification, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.length, ass.length ) length, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.material, ass.material ) material, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.drawing_number, ass.drawing_number ) drawing_number, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.net_weight, ass.net_weight ) net_weight, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.total_net_weight, ass.total_net_weight ) total_net_weight, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.gross_weight, ass.gross_weight ) gross_weight, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.total_gross_weight, ass.total_gross_weight ) total_gross_weight, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.quantity, ass.quantity ) quantity, IF( complete.task_type_enum = 1, par.id, ass.id ) id, complete.factory_id, complete.workshop_id, complete.quantity taskQuantity, complete.quantity warehouseQuantity, complete.task_type_enum AS productType, p.id 'project.id', p.NAME 'project.name', p.short_name 'project.short_name', p.serial_number 'project.serial_number', m.`id` 'monomer.id', m.`name` 'monomer.name', d.`id` 'area.id', d.`name` 'area.name', batch.`id` 'areaBatch.id', batch.`name` 'areaBatch.name' FROM (SELECT project_id, monomer_id, area_id, area_batch_id, task_type_enum, product_id, SUM( quantity )quantity, factory_id, workshop_id FROM mes_building_complete WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND task_type_enum & 17 AND task_id IS NULL
AND production_line_id = #{lineId}
AND area_batch_id = #{areaBatchId}
AND area_id = #{areaId} AND task_id is null GROUP BY project_id, monomer_id, area_id, area_batch_id, factory_id, workshop_id, task_type_enum, product_id) complete LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ass ON ass.id = complete.product_id AND ass.bool_send_directly = 1 AND ass.bool_process = 0 LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part par ON par.id = complete.product_id AND par.bool_send_directly = 1 AND par.bool_process = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project p ON complete.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer m ON m.id = complete.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area d ON d.id = complete.area_id LEFT JOIN plan_area_batch batch ON batch .id = complete.area_batch_id )a where 1=1
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{name},'%')
AND a.serial_number LIKE CONCAT('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
AND a.specification LIKE CONCAT('%',#{specification},'%')
AND a.material LIKE CONCAT('%',#{material},'%')

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(rec.create_time,'%Y-%m') date, shop.id workShopId, shop.name workShopName, sum(rec.quantity) completeQuantity, sum(rec.quantity * art.net_weight) netWeightSum FROM mes_building_warehouse_record rec LEFT JOIN tech_artifact art ON rec.product_id = art.id AND art.bool_delete_enum = 0 where rec.bool_delete_enum = 0 and rec.product_type = 2 and rec.type = 1 and DATE_FORMAT(rec.create_time,'%Y') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(rec.create_time,'%Y-%m');
